title: build new in a project that has repo builds but no jitso/jitso.yaml exits 3 with the missing-allowlists message and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped core and templates; docs/decisions.md D7). The skeleton is written only in a fresh project. When `jitso/builds/` holds builds and `jitso/jitso.yaml` is missing, the project is broken, not new: `jitso build new` exits 3 with `jitso: jitso/jitso.yaml is missing: this project has no JITSO allowlists (create it with jitso build new <id>)`, like every catalog command, and writes neither the skeleton nor a draft. The oracle has no `build new` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the written file or the printed line FAILS on it.

stderr.contains: jitso: jitso/jitso.yaml is missing: this project has no JITSO allowlists (create it with jitso build new <id>)
